Rosé (singer) :: Life and career :: 1997–2012: Early life :: chunk_0002
Roseanne Park, Korean name Park Chae-young (박채영), was born on 11 February 1997[[3]](#cite_note-blackpinkINSTA-4)[[4]](#cite_note-ygTWITTER-5) in [Auckland](/wiki/Auckland "Auckland"), New Zealand, to South Korean immigrant parents,[[5]](#cite_note-scmp18-6) and has an older sister.[[6]](#cite_note-7) In 2004, at the age of seven, Rosé and her family moved to [Melbourne](/wiki/Melbourne "Melbourne"), Australia,[[7]](#cite_note-smh-8) where she spent her childhood.[[8]](#cite_note-9) She began singing and learned to play guitar and piano as a child and performed in church choirs.[[7]](#cite_note-smh-8)[[9]](#cite_note-10) She attended Kew East Primary School in [Kew East](/wiki/Kew_East "Kew East")[[10]](#cite_note-voguekorea-11) and [Canterbury Girls' Secondary College](/wiki/Canterbury_Girls%27_Secondary_College "Canterbury Girls' Secondary College") in [Canterbury, Victoria](/wiki/Canterbury,_Victoria "Canterbury, Victoria"), a Melbourne suburb, but dropped out before year 11, after signing with South Korean record label [YG Entertainment](/wiki/YG_Entertainment "YG Entertainment").[[11]](#cite_note-nme.com-12)

fanoutqa_021090.t: Flag of Oregon :: Design and symbolism :: chunk_0002
fanoutqa_021090.x:
Flag of Oregon :: Design and symbolism :: chunk_0002
The navy blue flag field with lettering and symbols in gold, represents the state colors of Oregon.[[4]](#cite_note-obb-4)[[5]](#cite_note-Shearer-5) The 33 stars surrounding the shield represents Oregon's admission to the Union as the 33rd state. Below the shield is written *1859*, the year in which Oregon became a state.[[4]](#cite_note-obb-4)

Oregon's flag is the last remaining state flag in the U.S. in which the obverse and reverse sides have different designs.[[6]](#cite_note-mw-6) [Paraguay](/wiki/Flag_of_Paraguay "Flag of Paraguay")[[7]](#cite_note-7) is the only country that still has a two-sided flag. Two-sided flags were previously more common, but have been reduced due to increased costs of manufacturing a flag with two different designs.[[6]](#cite_note-mw-6) On the reverse of the flag is a depiction, also in gold, of a [beaver](/wiki/North_American_beaver "North American beaver"), the [state animal](/wiki/List_of_U.S._state_mammals "List of U.S. state mammals") of Oregon.[[4]](#cite_note-obb-4)

For dress or parade use, the flag may feature a gold fringe. For standard use, no fringe is required.[[4]](#cite_note-obb-4) The ratio of the flag's width to its length is 3:5.[[8]](#cite_note-fotw2-8)

It is one of nine U.S. state flags to feature an eagle, alongside those of [Illinois](/wiki/Flag_of_Illinois "Flag of Illinois"), [Iowa](/wiki/Flag_of_Iowa "Flag of Iowa"), [Michigan](/wiki/Flag_of_Michigan "Flag of Michigan"), [Missouri](/wiki/Flag_of_Missouri "Flag of Missouri"), [New York](/wiki/Coat_of_arms_of_New_York "Coat of arms of New York"), [North Dakota](/wiki/Flag_of_North_Dakota "Flag of North Dakota"), [Pennsylvania](/wiki/Flag_of_Pennsylvania "Flag of Pennsylvania"), and [Wyoming](/wiki/Flag_of_Wyoming "Flag of Wyoming").

fanoutqa_021346.x:
Mongolia :: part 03 :: chunk_0002
**Mongolia**[[b]](#cite_note-11)[[c]](#cite_note-12) is a [landlocked country](/wiki/Landlocked_country "Landlocked country") in the [East Asia](/wiki/East_Asia "East Asia") region. It is bordered by [Russia](/wiki/Russia "Russia") to the north and [China](/wiki/China "China") to the south, and covers an area of 1,564,116 square kilometers (603,909 square miles), making it the [18th-largest country](/wiki/List_of_countries_and_dependencies_by_area "List of countries and dependencies by area") in the world and the second largest landlocked country after [Kazakhstan](/wiki/Kazakhstan "Kazakhstan"), as well as the largest landlocked country that does not border an [inland sea](/wiki/Endorheic_basin "Endorheic basin"). With a population of 3.5 million, Mongolia is the world's [most sparsely populated sovereign state](/wiki/List_of_countries_and_dependencies_by_population_density "List of countries and dependencies by population density"), excluding partially unrecognized [Western Sahara](/wiki/Sahrawi_Arab_Democratic_Republic "Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic"). The country constitutes a significant portion of the [Mongolian Plateau](/wiki/Mongolian_Plateau "Mongolian Plateau"), and its natural environment is characterized by grassy [steppe](/wiki/Steppe "Steppe"), mountains to the north and west, and the [Gobi Desert](/wiki/Gobi_Desert "Gobi Desert") to the south. [Ulaanbaatar](/wiki/Ulaanbaatar "Ulaanbaatar"), the capital and [largest city](/wiki/List_of_cities_in_Mongolia "List of cities in Mongolia"), is home to roughly half of the country's population.

fanoutqa_032610.x:
Telephone numbers in Indonesia :: Overview :: Numbers in business contact information :: chunk_0001
On business cards and other contact information, telephone numbers might be listed as "HP" or "hunting". "HP" is an abbreviation for "hand phone" or [mobile phone](/wiki/Mobile_phone "Mobile phone") and is pronounced "hah péh". Hand phones might also be referred to as *pon-sel* (short form of *telepon seluler*) or *telepon genggam* ("hold-in-the-hand telephone"). Hunting refers to [line hunting](/wiki/Line_hunting "Line hunting"), an office line in which multiple individual lines are connected so that an incoming call can roll over to another line if the first line is busy. This permits only one number to be published.

International call operators:

* [PT Indosat](/wiki/Indosat "Indosat"): 101
* [PT Telkom](/wiki/Telkom_Indonesia "Telkom Indonesia"): 107

Domestic call operators: 100
International phone number information: 102

fanoutqa_004194.x:
Astro (South Korean band) :: Career :: Pre-debut :: chunk_0001
Astro was formed through the rookie talent development program "i-Teen", which was created by their agency [Fantagio](/wiki/Fantagio "Fantagio").[[6]](#cite_note-6) In August 2015, the final member line-up and group name were announced.[[7]](#cite_note-7) The same month, the group starred in a web drama titled *To Be Continued*, which aimed to introduce them to the public. The drama featured the members as themselves, as well as [Kim Sae-ron](/wiki/Kim_Sae-ron "Kim Sae-ron"), [Seo Kang-joon](/wiki/Seo_Kang-joon "Seo Kang-joon"), and the girl group [Hello Venus](/wiki/Hello_Venus "Hello Venus").[[8]](#cite_note-8)

After their web drama finished airing, the group started the "Meet U" project. As part of the project, Astro traveled through South Korea, covering songs in front of crowds and holding fan meetings. Along with the performances, a KakaoTalk Plus Friends account was set up. Fantagio stated that once the group had gathered 10,000 friends on the app, they would announce their official debut date.[[9]](#cite_note-9) The goal was met by December 2015.[[10]](#cite_note-10) Their debut showcase, held on January 28, 2016, was sold out in under a minute and far exceeded the original limit of 1,000 attendants.[[11]](#cite_note-11)[[12]](#cite_note-12) There, they also announced their official fan club name, Aroha.

They also appeared in their own reality TV show titled *Astro OK! Ready*, which began airing on January 21, 2016, on [MBC every1](/wiki/MBC_every1 "MBC every1")[[13]](#cite_note-13) and concluded on February 18, 2016.[[14]](#cite_note-14)

Uranus :: History :: chunk_0005
[![](//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/61/Discovery_of_Uranus1781.png/250px-Discovery_of_Uranus1781.png)](/wiki/File:Discovery_of_Uranus1781.png)

Position of Uranus (marked with a cross) on 13 March 1781, the date of its discovery

Like the [classical planets](/wiki/Classical_planet "Classical planet"), Uranus is visible to the naked eye, but it was never recognised as a planet by ancient observers because of its dimness and slow orbit.[[28]](#cite_note-34) [William Herschel](/wiki/William_Herschel "William Herschel") first observed Uranus on 13 March 1781, leading to its discovery as a planet, expanding the known boundaries of the [Solar System](/wiki/Solar_System "Solar System") for the first time in history and making Uranus the first planet classified as such with the aid of a [telescope](/wiki/Telescope "Telescope"). The discovery of Uranus also effectively doubled the size of the known Solar System because Uranus is around twice as far from the Sun as the planet [Saturn](/wiki/Saturn "Saturn").

Narcissus (plant) :: Description :: Phytochemistry :: Alkaloids :: chunk_0007
As with all Amaryllidaceae genera, *Narcissus* contains unique [isoquinoline](/wiki/Isoquinoline "Isoquinoline") [alkaloids](/wiki/Alkaloid "Alkaloid"). The first alkaloid to be identified was [lycorine](/wiki/Lycorine "Lycorine"), from *N. pseudonarcissus* in 1877. These are considered a protective adaptation and are utilised in the classification of species. Nearly 100 alkaloids have been identified in the genus, about a third of all known Amaryllidaceae alkaloids, although not all species have been tested. Of the nine alkaloid [ring](/wiki/Ring_(chemistry) "Ring (chemistry)") types identified in the family, *Narcissus* species most commonly demonstrate the presence of alkaloids from within the Lycorine (lycorine, galanthine, pluviine) and [Homolycorine](/wiki/Homolycorine "Homolycorine") (homolycorine, lycorenine) groups. Hemanthamine, tazettine, [narciclasine](/wiki/Narciclasine "Narciclasine"), montanine and [galantamine](/wiki/Galantamine "Galantamine") alkaloids are also represented. The alkaloid profile of any plant varies with time, location, and developmental stage.[[24]](#cite_note-Bastida-25) *Narcissus* also contain [fructans](/wiki/Fructans "Fructans") and low molecular weight [glucomannan](/wiki/Glucomannan "Glucomannan") in the leaves and plant stems.

Host nation [China](/wiki/China_at_the_2008_Summer_Olympics "China at the 2008 Summer Olympics") won the most gold medals (48), and became the seventh different team to top the Summer Olympics medal standings, winning a total of 100 medals overall. The [United States](/wiki/United_States_at_the_2008_Summer_Olympics "United States at the 2008 Summer Olympics") placed second in the gold medal tally but won the highest number of medals overall (112). The third place in the gold and overall medal tally was achieved by [Russia](/wiki/Russia_at_the_2008_Summer_Olympics "Russia at the 2008 Summer Olympics").

This Olympic Games marked the return of the Summer Olympic Games to Asia after the 1988 Olympics in South Korea. It was the first Olympics for [Serbia](/wiki/Serbia "Serbia") as a separate state since 1912 and the first for [Montenegro](/wiki/Montenegro "Montenegro"), having separated from Serbia in 2006. It was also the first Olympics for [Nepal](/wiki/Nepal "Nepal") as a republic, the [Marshall Islands](/wiki/Marshall_Islands "Marshall Islands") and [Tuvalu](/wiki/Tuvalu "Tuvalu"). [Mongolia](/wiki/Mongolia "Mongolia") and [Panama](/wiki/Panama "Panama") each won their first Olympic gold medal. In addition, [Afghanistan](/wiki/Afghanistan "Afghanistan"), [Mauritius](/wiki/Mauritius "Mauritius"), Serbia, [Sudan](/wiki/Sudan "Sudan"), [Tajikistan](/wiki/Tajikistan "Tajikistan") and [Togo](/wiki/Togo "Togo") won their first Olympic medals at these Games. Ann Arbor, Michigan :: part 02 :: chunk_0001
**Ann Arbor** is a city in [Washtenaw County, Michigan](/wiki/Washtenaw_County,_Michigan "Washtenaw County, Michigan"), United States, of which it is the [county seat](/wiki/County_seat "County seat"). It had a population of 123,851 in 2020, making it the fifth most populous in Michigan.

The city is home to the [University of Michigan](/wiki/University_of_Michigan "University of Michigan"), the [oldest university](/wiki/List_of_colleges_and_universities_in_Michigan "List of colleges and universities in Michigan") in the state. Its economy is primarily focused on [high technology](/wiki/High_technology "High technology"), with numerous [startup companies](/wiki/Startup_companies "Startup companies") drawn to the area due to the university's robust [research and development](/wiki/Research_and_development "Research and development") activities.

Founded in 1824 with American settlers from the [East Coast](/wiki/East_Coast_of_the_United_States "East Coast of the United States"), it was incorporated as a city in 1851. The city is located on the [Huron River](/wiki/Huron_River "Huron River"). It is the principal city of its [metropolitan area](/wiki/Metropolitan_statistical_area "Metropolitan statistical area"), and it is also included in the [Detroit–Warren–Ann Arbor combined statistical area](/wiki/Metro_Detroit "Metro Detroit") as well as the [Great Lakes megalopolis](/wiki/Great_Lakes_megalopolis "Great Lakes megalopolis").

The **Philadelphia Phillies** are an American professional [baseball](/wiki/Baseball "Baseball") team based in [Philadelphia](/wiki/Philadelphia "Philadelphia"). The Phillies compete in [Major League Baseball](/wiki/Major_League_Baseball "Major League Baseball") (MLB) as a member club of the [National League](/wiki/National_League_(baseball) "National League (baseball)") (NL) [East Division](/wiki/National_League_East "National League East"). Since 2004, the team's home stadium has been [Citizens Bank Park](/wiki/Citizens_Bank_Park "Citizens Bank Park"), located in the [South Philadelphia Sports Complex](/wiki/South_Philadelphia_Sports_Complex "South Philadelphia Sports Complex").[[8]](#cite_note-8)[[9]](#cite_note-9)[[10]](#cite_note-10)[[11]](#cite_note-11)

The National League approved a new franchise for Philadelphia to begin play in 1883, at its annual meeting in Providence on December 7, 1882.[[12]](#cite_note-12) The Phillies are the oldest, continuous, one-name, one-city franchise in American professional sports and one of the most storied teams in Major League Baseball.[[13]](#cite_note-13) Since their founding, the Phillies have won two [World Series](/wiki/World_Series "World Series") championships (against the [Kansas City Royals](/wiki/Kansas_City_Royals "Kansas City Royals") in [1980](/wiki/1980_World_Series "1980 World Series") and the [Tampa Bay Rays](/wiki/Tampa_Bay_Rays "Tampa Bay Rays") in [2008](/wiki/2008_World_Series "2008 World Series")) and eight [National League pennants](/wiki/National_League_pennant "National League pennant") (the first of which came [in 1915](/wiki/1915_Philadelphia_Phillies_season "1915 Philadelphia Phillies season")). The team has played 122 consecutive seasons since the [first modern World Series](/wiki/1903_World_Series "1903 World Series") and 142 seasons since its inaugural 1883 campaign.
